basic_info.description: Welcome to this grand residence that offers space for everyone with 4 bedrooms and 4 full baths!  As you step inside, you're greeted by an impressive living room featuring high ceilings, a fireplace and recessed lighting, perfect for those relaxing evenings. Just beyond, you'll find a formal dining room waiting to host your dinner parties. The kitchen is bright and spacious.  Additionally on the main level, there is a large bedroom, a full bathroom, a home office space plus a wonderful large deck for outdoor gatherings and outdoor dinners.  The top floor features two elegant bedroom suites, with the primary suite enjoying the luxury of a private deck that overlooks the garden and city life.  Head down to the lower level, where a bedroom and bathroom allow for flexible living arrangements ideal for guests, an in-law suite or rental income.  The rear garden patio provides a peaceful setting for outdoor gatherings and area for a garden of your choice.  The outlook and views from the two decks are special offering far reaching views of the sky, trees and city life.   The garage includes space for a parked car and an enormous storage area.  This home is wonderfully located near shops, restaurants, parks and schools and has been recently upgraded with many new features.
